/* Synced from wiki-pages/MediaWiki/Common.css.wiki in the repository: edit it there. */

/* Phones (Vector is responsive, $wgVectorResponsive): infoboxes stop floating beside the text,
   and wide tables scroll sideways instead of widening the page. */
@media screen and (max-width: 720px) {
	.rewiki-infobox {
		float: none !important;
		width: auto !important;
		margin: 0 0 1em 0 !important;
	}
	.mw-parser-output table.wikitable,
	table.mw-json {
		display: block;
		overflow-x: auto;
		max-width: 100%;
	}
}
